name: Nagybajom (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and green in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Nagybajom: a blue shield with a white bird on a green base, with a mural crown, within a wreath of oak.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagybajom arms with mural crown and wreath
